# ClickUp API

Project Management / Work Management / All-in-One Workspace · clickup.com

ClickUp offers a documented public REST API at developer.clickup.com with personal tokens or OAuth 2.0 and native HMAC-signed webhooks. Access comes with every plan, but rate limits are plan-gated: 100 requests per minute per token until Business Plus. Whiteboards and Dashboards have no API.

Last verified: November 2026Software & Data ToolsMCP READYCLOUD

API GRADE

A

VERIFIED NOV 2026

## SCORECARD

ExistenceGOODPublic REST API at api.clickup.com (v2 core, v3 Docs and Chat surfaces); JSON only.

AccessGOODEvery plan includes API access with self-serve personal tokens; rate limits scale by plan from 100 requests per minute.

CoverageGOODTasks, spaces, custom fields, comments, time tracking, goals, docs, chat, and views; Whiteboards and Dashboards have no API.

AuthGOODPersonal tokens for individual use plus a standard OAuth 2.0 three-legged flow for apps.

Docs & DXGOODFull docs at developer.clickup.com, native HMAC-signed webhooks, and 429s with X-RateLimit headers.

StabilityGOODThe v2 core has been long-lived; newer Docs and Chat APIs land additively on a v3 path.

MCPGOODClickUp runs an official hosted MCP server (public beta) at mcp.clickup.com covering tasks, docs, comments, time tracking, and search, with OAuth-only authentication. Connection instructions for major AI clients are documented on developer.clickup.com and help.clickup.com. [developer.clickup.com ↗](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/connect-an-ai-assistant-to-clickups-mcp-server) VERIFIED 2026-08

**Supergood** turns hard-to-integrate enterprise software into clean REST APIs and MCP tools: stable endpoints, normalized JSON, managed auth.

## Frequently asked questions

###

ClickUp scores A on Supergood's API Report Card. ClickUp offers a documented public REST API at developer.clickup.com with personal tokens or OAuth 2.0 and native HMAC-signed webhooks. Access comes with every plan, but rate limits are plan-gated: 100 requests per minute per token until Business Plus. Whiteboards and Dashboards have no API.

Tried to integrate with ClickUp?

SOURCES

100 req/min per-token ceiling on Free, Unlimited, and Business tiers traps multi-team integrators, sync jobs, and AI-agent workloads, a single overactive Zapier/Make/n8n flow can burn the entire quota [developer.clickup.com ↗](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/rate-limits)

Per-plan rate-limit gating forces customers onto Business Plus (1,000 req/min) or Enterprise (10,000 req/min) primarily to unlock programmatic headroom, not for feature value [consultevo.com ↗](https://consultevo.com/clickup-api-rate-limits-guide/)

Rate limits are per-token, so each integration burns separately, large orgs with many Zapier/Make/n8n flows, internal scripts, and AI agents collide on the same workspace despite separate tokens [peter.solymos.org ↗](https://peter.solymos.org/clickrup/reference/cu-ratelimit.html)

Pagination on List Tasks is offset-based with a hard 100-task page cap, requiring many sequential round-trips for full-workspace exports and amplifying rate-limit pressure [developer.clickup.com ↗](https://developer.clickup.com/reference/gettasks)

Docs API and Chat API are on a separate `/v3/` path with different conventions than the main `/v2/` API, increasing integrator complexity [developer.clickup.com ↗](https://developer.clickup.com/docs)

Whiteboards and Dashboards have no first-class API surface, making full-workspace backup and migration impossible without manual export [smartsuite.com ↗](https://www.smartsuite.com/blog/clickup-review)

Custom field values are returned as opaque IDs in some response shapes and require separate field-definition lookups to dereference, increasing call volume [developer.clickup.com ↗](https://developer.clickup.com/reference/setcustomfieldvalue)

Webhook delivery reliability has been a long-running complaint, community reports of dropped events, no built-in replay endpoint, and webhook subscriptions that silently stop firing [developer.clickup.com ↗](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/webhooks)

Brain (AI) and Super Agent calls do not expose token-level rate-limit headers separately from REST API limits, making it hard to plan AI-agent workloads [clickup.com ↗](https://clickup.com/blog/clickup-api/)

Audit log access is Enterprise-only, limiting security/compliance integrations on lower tiers [help.clickup.com ↗](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6303426241687-Use-the-ClickUp-API)

API documentation has had reliability issues, the developer.clickup.com docs portal returned HTTP 503 during this research session [developer.clickup.com ↗](https://developer.clickup.com/)

OAuth app creation is gated to Workspace owner/admin only, blocking line-of-business teams from standing up sanctioned integrations without admin involvement [developer.clickup.com ↗](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/authentication)

Performance is sluggish on large workspaces, Lists with 500+ tasks and many custom fields get noticeably laggy, board views feel sluggish past 100 cards, and complex Dashboards/Gantt views can take seconds to load [smartsuite.com ↗](https://www.smartsuite.com/blog/clickup-review)

Steep learning curve and feature overwhelm, 30+ views, deep hierarchy, hundreds of toggleable ClickApps, and a constantly-expanding surface area make onboarding hard for non-technical teams [learn.g2.com ↗](https://learn.g2.com/clickup-review)

Mobile app is buggy and slow, especially on heavier workspaces, long-running G2/Capterra complaint [g2.com ↗](https://www.g2.com/products/clickup/reviews?qs=pros-and-cons)

Notifications are noisy by default and require significant tuning to be usable [taskrhino.ca ↗](https://www.taskrhino.ca/blog/clickup-review/)

Automations can be slow to trigger or unreliable in more complex multi-step workflows [smartsuite.com ↗](https://www.smartsuite.com/blog/clickup-review)

Frequent UI/feature churn, ClickUp ships aggressively (multiple releases per week historically) and customers report breaking changes to views, custom fields, and automations between releases [thebusinessdive.com ↗](https://thebusinessdive.com/clickup-review)

StatusGator has tracked >474 ClickUp outages over ~6 years, across 63 monitored components and 3 service groups [statusgator.com ↗](https://statusgator.com/services/clickup)

Pricing tier confusion, Free Forever caps storage at 100MB and has aggressive view/feature limits; Unlimited ($7/user/mo) and Business ($12/user/mo) tier-gate Dashboards widgets, Goals, advanced permissions, and time-tracking features customers expect [costbench.com ↗](https://costbench.com/software/project-management/clickup/)

Per-user pricing scales painfully on monthly billing (Unlimited $10/user/mo monthly vs $7 annual; Business $19/user/mo monthly vs $12 annual) [smartsuite.com ↗](https://www.smartsuite.com/blog/clickup-pricing)

Brain (AI) is a paid add-on (~$7/user/mo) on top of any paid tier, and AI credits / usage caps have been confusing for buyers [checkthat.ai ↗](https://checkthat.ai/brands/clickup/pricing)

May 2026 22% layoffs and aggressive 'AI 100x org' restructuring under CEO Zeb Evans create real customer concern about product stability and roadmap continuity [aieatingtheworld.com ↗](https://www.aieatingtheworld.com/articles/clickup-layoffs-22-percent-ai-restructuring-million-dollar-salary)

Reporting and Dashboards are powerful but query-heavy widgets slow workspace load times, and aggregation across Spaces is awkward [taskrhino.ca ↗](https://www.taskrhino.ca/blog/clickup-review-2026-honest-analysis/)

Migration off ClickUp is painful, export fidelity for Docs, Whiteboards, Dashboards, and custom-field relationships is mediocre, and full-workspace export requires the API and custom tooling [smartsuite.com ↗](https://www.smartsuite.com/blog/clickup-review)
